scope: DEV-calibrated candidate; observed timezone FN is already known, not a fresh test
source_trigger: Ambiguous call/result pairing OR differing observed values at identical tool/entity/path scope OR an aware-ISO policy literal plus an aware-ISO preceding result literal
uncertainty_trigger: Exactly 3 valid same-input judge samples; agreement<1 OR native judge-explanation NLI contradiction>=0.5
random_control: Deterministic content-hash priority with seed1729; select exactly the same count from primary NO_ERROR inputs
random_limit: Equal query fraction, not equal token cost; cost must still be measured separately
independent_review: Same source-bound-v2 B on original full input, no semantic proposal promoted as proof
quality_measurement: Routing inclusion alone is not downstream FN recovery
